roles.title: Sr. Product Manager, Borrow and Operations
roles.location: NC - Charlotte; FL - Jacksonville; TX - Frisco

bullets: Own the product charter for Borrow & Operations technology: vision, scope, success measures, and the business goals the roadmap exists to hit.
Set and sequence the Home Lending application roadmap across origination, underwriting, document management, eSignature and eVault, bureau and third-party integrations, payments…
Lead a new team focused on the Borrow and Home Lending lines of business. Plan their work, coach them, and make resourcing and priority calls so day-to-day administration…
Lead cross-functional discovery with Home Lending Operations, Engineering, Product, Risk, Compliance, Security, Identity and Access Management, and vendors. Turn operational…
Decide what to build, configure, automate, or stop. Assess alternatives, operational risk, regulatory impact, and cost, and shape how IT supports Borrow operations.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager
roles.location: CA - San Francisco; NY - New York City; WA - Seattle

bullets: Own and evolve the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for your product area.
Break vision into phases, prioritize, and drive backlogs for launch with your dedicated engineering teams.
Drive platform and product strategy focused on scalability, reliability, security, and regulatory compliance.
Partner deeply with engineering to make critical architectural decisions and guide long-term investments.
Engage with risk, compliance, legal, and security teams to align product capabilities with regulatory requirements.

roles.title: Senior Product Manager
roles.location: CA - San Francisco; NY - New York City; WA- Seattle

bullets: Define and execute on a product vision and multi-year roadmap for your product area.
Prioritize and drive backlogs for launch with your dedicated engineering teams, writing detailed requirements and partnering closely with developers.
Own instrumentation, data, and analysis for your products to drive deep understanding, innovation, and product plans.
Work cross-functionally with stakeholders across design, engineering, marketing, operations, legal, compliance, risk, and executive leadership to translate customer needs into…
Lead experiments and hypothesis-driven work to validate ideas and measure impact on key business and member outcomes.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Commercial Banking
roles.location: CA - San Francisco; NY - New York City; WA - Seattle

bullets: Define the multi-year product vision and roadmap for Commercial Banking
Own and deliver client facing experiences and APIs and end-to-end platform: business accounts, payments rails (Wires, ACH, FedNow), treasury capabilities, and APIs
Lead 0→1 product development from discovery through launch and scale
Manage and grow a product team to drive roadmap and delivery as business scales
Partner cross-functionally with Business, Engineering, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, Finance, Sales and Operations teams to bring product roadmap to life
